findings.rule_quote: "Specific waiting period" means a period up to 36 months from the commencement of a health insurance policy during which period specified diseases/treatments (except due to an accident) are not covered.
findings.question_en: Which specific waiting period does the policy apply, and how many months of cover were completed?
findings.action_en: Compare the insurer's cited period with the policy wording and the regulatory cap.
